items.title: Why Stryker (SYK) Stock Is Trading Up Today
items.summary: Shares of medical technology company Stryker (NYSE:SYK) jumped 2.7% in the afternoon session after its Stryker Sales unit in Michigan won a $100 million contract modification from the US Defense Logistics Agency.
